name: What credentials or certifications should a blood cleanup company have?

mainEntity.name: What credentials or certifications should a blood cleanup company have?

acceptedAnswer.text: A reputable blood cleanup company should possess specific credentials and certifications to ensure competence and safety. Look for companies whose technicians are trained and certified in biohazard remediation, bloodborne pathogen cleanup, and confined space entry if applicable. Certifications from organizations like the IICRC (Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification) are indicators of professional standards and expertise in the field.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for blood cleanup companies with technicians certified in biohazard remediation and bloodborne pathogen cleanup, often by organizations like the IICRC.
